items.source: Uses of RequestBodyAdviceAdapter in org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation
A RequestBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for Jackson's @JsonView annotation declared on a Spring MVC @HttpEntity or @RequestBody method parameter.
items.translation: 一个实现了RequestBodyAdvice的类，它为在 Spring MVC 的@HttpEntity或@RequestBody方法参数上声明的 Jackson@JsonView注解提供支持。

items.source: A RequestBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for resolving Kotlin KType from the parameter and providing it as a hint with a "kotlin.reflect.KType" key.
items.translation: 一个实现了RequestBodyAdvice的类，用于支持从参数中解析 Kotlin KType 并将其作为带有"kotlin.reflect.KType"键的提示提供。

items.source: MVC infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing, building on the org.springframework.web.method.annotation package.
items.translation: 基于 org.springframework.web.method.annotation 包构建的用于注解式处理器方法处理的 MVC 基础设施。
